look_here_first: Find the underground BULB and basal trifoliolate leaves: the flowering scapes are separate, LEAFLESS stalks. Compare the broad, deeply notched leaflets (usually 14–34 mm, notch reaching 1/4–4/5 leaflet length) and ABSENCE of oxalate lines by the notch with the smaller, shallowly notched O. violacea. Inspect orange sepal-tip tubercles with a hand lens.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Stemless bulbous perennial; solitary bulb; leaves basal, flowering stalks (scapes) separate and leafless.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Three basal leaflets, obtriangular to obcordate, (6–)14–34 mm, notched 1/4–4/5 of length; oxalate lines near notch absent; blades usually glabrous.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Scapes generally 11–23 cm; cymes 3–10-flowered; petals white/greenish near base and pink/violet distally, (8–)15–23 mm; 5 sepals with usually 2 orange apical tubercles.

key_traits.label: Fruit
key_traits.text: Hairy cylindrical capsules 4–12 mm; inspect mature capsules rather than color alone.
